Title: Twilight Rebellion allowed for sanctioned tournament ? (LSJ)

Messages.Author: Stone
Messages.Body:
WW's site indicates Twilight Rebellion is released on May 28th.
Will the set be legal for a sanctioned tournament on June 28th ? The VEKN
rules mention "V:EKN announcements confirm the exact date that each new card
set enters tournament play before the set is released.", but I either didn't
see anything announced or missed it.
Stone

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:


Sets are always legal 30 days after release.
So Twilight Rebellion will be legal on June 27.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Sorry for the oversight.

The set becomes legal on Jun 27, 2008.

(May 28, 2008 + 30)
